environment.description: Apollo Server v4 deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance accessed through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction mode with prepared statement support (server_prepared_statements=yes). Database connection uses role 'app_service' which has SELECT privilege only through a security-barrier view layer. The views (v_users, v_documents) are defined with RLS-equivalent filtering using session variable 'app.current_user_id' set via SET LOCAL at transaction start. PgBouncer's server_reset_query is configured to 'DISCARD ALL' ensuring session variables cannot leak between pooled connections. The application sets 'SET LOCAL app.current_user_id' but this is handled by a pg middleware hook that fires on pool.connect, reading from the request context. However, the critical gate is that the security-barrier views enforce: v_users returns only the row WHERE id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid for sensitive columns (ssn, salary), and v_documents returns only rows WHERE owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid. Non-sensitive user fields (id, email, name, department) are accessible without restriction through a separate v_users_public view.

db_views.v_users: CREATE VIEW v_users WITH (security_barrier=true) AS SELECT id, email, name, CASE WHEN id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid THEN ssn ELSE NULL END as ssn, CASE WHEN id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid THEN salary ELSE NULL END as salary, department FROM users
db_views.v_documents: CREATE VIEW v_documents WITH (security_barrier=true) AS SELECT id, title, CASE WHEN owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid THEN content ELSE '[REDACTED]' END as content, owner_id, classification FROM documents WHERE classification != 'TOP_SECRET' OR owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid

config.db_role_privileges: GRANT SELECT ON v_users, v_users_public, v_documents TO app_service; REVOKE ALL ON users, documents FROM app_service
config.pg_middleware: pool.on('connect', async (client) => { /* SET LOCAL app.current_user_id called per-transaction */ })
